prompt.alinti: This is Claude on low effort, and this is Claude on ultra code. Now, I'm going to show you Claude at every effort level. This is low, which Claude's own team builds almost everything on. This is medium, which is the default you're on unless you changed it. Now, this is high, which Claude's team only uses to test the work Claude does. And this is extra high, where Claude tries to break what it built to make the result much better. And this is max, which should be used for hard jobs it does without you, but Claude's own docs warns that it overthinks a lot. And this is ultra code, where dozens of Claude's split one task and check each other's work, which means picking the right level saves your limit for the jobs that actually need it.
